title.value: L AUGHING H YENA D ISTILLERY Extracting Compact Recurrences From Convolutions
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: L AUGHING H YENA D ISTILLERY Extracting Compact Recurrences From Convolutions

extractions.description: The paper introduces LaughingHyena, a distillation method for long convolution sequence models (LCSMs) that enables recurrent inference with constant memory and high throughput, without sacrificing downstream quality. It also introduces architectural improvements to convolution-based layers such as Hyena, by weight-tying the filters across channels into heads, achieving higher pretraining quality and reducing the number of filters to be distilled.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is about improving the efficiency of deep learning models, but it does not focus on any specific Sustainable Development Goal. However, the efficiency gains could contribute to reducing energy consumption.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Efficiency Our distillation methods for constant-memory, high throughput inference in long convolution sequence models (LCSMs) can lead to energy savings during model deployement, enabling processing of longer-form content at a fraction of the cost and reducing environmental impact.
